## Contributor License Agreement (CLA)

First-time contributors must sign the CLA before this PR can merge.

- [ ] I have signed the [Individual CLA](https://github.com/awide-labs/polar/blob/POLARDB_15_STABLE/legal/INDIVIDUAL-CLA.md) (version 1.0),

**How to sign (manual process):**

1. Open a [CLA signing issue](https://github.com/awide-labs/polar/issues/new?template=cla_signing.yml)
   or email `info@awide.io` with subject `Awide Polar ICLA`.
2. Wait for a maintainer to confirm your signature on file.
3. A maintainer will add the `cla-signed` label to this PR after verification.

Returning contributors: if you have already signed the current CLA version, a
maintainer still adds `cla-signed` on each PR until CLA signing is automated.
